description: This file defines the Gvk struct and associated methods for representing and manipulating Kubernetes API types, including parsing, string conversion, comparison, and scope determination.

classes.name: Gvk
classes.description: Represents a Kubernetes Group-Version-Kind (GVK) with methods for parsing, comparison, and string representation.

methods.name: NewGvk
methods.description: Constructs a Gvk object from group, version, and kind strings, determining cluster scope.

methods.name: GvkFromNode
methods.description: Creates a Gvk from a YAML node by extracting API version and kind.

methods.name: FromKind
methods.description: Creates a Gvk with only the kind specified.

methods.name: ParseGroupVersion
methods.description: Parses an apiVersion string into group and version components.

methods.name: GvkFromString
methods.description: Creates a Gvk from its string representation.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Gvk.

methods.name: stableSortString
methods.description: Returns a deterministic string for sorting and testing.

methods.name: ApiVersion
methods.description: Returns the combined group and version string.

methods.name: StringWoEmptyField
methods.description: Returns a filename-friendly string omitting empty fields.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality of two Gvk objects.

methods.name: IsLessThan
methods.description: Determines ordering between two Gvk objects for sorting.

methods.name: IsSelected
methods.description: Checks if the Gvk matches a selector Gvk.

methods.name: AsTypeMeta
methods.description: Converts Gvk to a yaml.TypeMeta object.

methods.name: IsClusterScoped
methods.description: Returns true if the Gvk is cluster scoped based on openapi data.
